statement: A guarded-source/grid placement with p4=1,p5=2,p6=1 and p10=1 has no other bracket or insert profiles because nonnegative family totals are4/1/4. Relabel its identical bracket copies into4/5/5/6 and its identical cog copies arbitrarily into the four9 slots. This gives exactly the audited full-stock source coordinate model, whose sole call returned INFEASIBLE. Therefore no placement in this source representation has all four profile counts. This does not transfer to another cog angle, source guard, continuous off-grid coordinates or unrestricted original packing.
